summary: Full-stack test of DigiLib after migration from mock React to FastAPI+MongoDB. Backend: 18/18 pytest passing (health, auth register/login/logout/me/wrong-pw/no-cookie, books CRUD w/ admin auth, member 403, loan borrow+return with stock decrement/increment, duplicate borrow 400, reservation FIFO with dup 400 and cancel re-index, admin members list/update/self-delete-400, admin loans w/ status filter, admin stats, cloudinary signature 400 when unconfigured and 403 for member). Frontend: home renders 15 books + featured, catalog search filters to 1 result for 'Pengantar', admin login shows Admin nav + all 4 tabs (books/members/loans/stats), Tambah koleksi (BookEditor) modal opens, member borrow triggers 'Peminjaman berhasil' toast, out-of-stock 'Masuk antrean reservasi' creates Antrean reservasi (FIFO) #1, return-loan and cancel-reservation work. All key data-testids present and functional.

issues: Some Unsplash cover images fail to load (e.g. 'Kimia Organik Dasar' shows broken image alt text). Consider onError fallback.

action_items: (Optional) Add onError fallback for broken cover images in book cards.
(Optional) Consider adding /api/loans/me shape for returned loans as history — currently returns all statuses, front-end could filter.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single ~730-line file; consider splitting into routers/auth,books,loans,admin modules once features grow.
Cookies use SameSite=None; Secure — correct for cross-origin preview; ensure production always serves over HTTPS.
Reservation reindex loop runs sequential update_one calls — fine at this scale, could be bulk_write for larger queues.
No rate limiting / brute-force lockout on /auth/login (playbook mentions 5-fail lockout) — not implemented; acceptable for MVP but note for hardening.
bcrypt hash format verified as $2b$ via seed path.
seed_data_creation: None; used existing seed. Tests create TEST_ prefixed books and clean them up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_digilib_api.py — run with pytest. All 18 pass on public URL. Frontend borrow/return/reservation flows verified through the preview URL. Cloudinary env vars intentionally empty; endpoint correctly returns 400 with Indonesian message.
